arn.text: Ashnod meets Mishra at Zegon, where she shows him the Staff of Zegon, and he takes her as his apprentice.
During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon so that she will protect Kayla.
Ashnod instead drains the Qadir's life with the staff, killing him, and Mishra becomes the last Qadir.

atq.text: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp to negotiate for Zegon and becomes his apprentice and lover, and at the Peace Summit she weakens Urza's automaton to free the Qadir, then during the Fall of Kroog kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape.

Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, and she later develops transmogrants and is made general of a campaign to conquer Korlis.
Ashnod wounds and captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains, takes the sylex and interrogates her in Almaaz.

At the Battle at Argoth she passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it, and she survives the blast, changes her appearance and name, and founds the Conclave of Mages by 80 AR with Tawnos.
